title: Analysis of microbial diversity under strongly alkaline conditions
description: To Characterize Microbial Diversity and Community Structure: The primary goal is to systematically investigate the composition, richness, and distribution of microbial communities (including bacteria, archaea, and fungi) in various strong alkaline environments, such as soda lakes and saline-alkaline soils . This involves identifying dominant microbial groups and understanding how these communities are assembled under alkaline stress.
